content.short: Atomic Wallet helps manage Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Litecoin, USDT, and over 1000 other coins and tokens.
content.description: Atomic Wallet is a decentralized, non-custodial wallet that serves as a bridge to the blockchain, ensuring that only you - the owner of your cryptocurrencies and NFTs - have access to your private keys. It offers a lightweight, multi-chain interface that supports more than 50 coins and 200 tokens, along with a peer-to-peer atomic swap exchange. The app also enables asset exchanges through instant exchangers, empowering you to swap and manage holdings securely within a single wallet.
